web.title_en: CVE-2026-6307: Missing Signature Comparison Causes Wasm Return Type Corruption
web.description_en: When TurboFan inlines two JS-to-Wasm call sites with different return types into the same function, the frame state equality check omits a comparison of Wasm signatures, causing two distinct frame states to be treated as identical. Following an inline deoptimization, return values are materialized using incorrect types—object addresses are read as integers, and integers are interpreted as object pointers.

web.description: eMudhra , an Indian certificate authority (CA), will withdraw from its global SSL/TLS certificate business,  its board decided on Thursday . The decision came five days after a researcher  reported recovering the private keys  of eight of its intermediate CA certificates.   eMudhra said it will replace affected customers' certificates with free ones from partners, though its announcement did not name the partners or provide a date for the exit.
